title: Canonical Factual Projection shared read-contract consolidation
objective: Make executive pages, diagnostics, Research Gaps and owner-assessment inputs consume one governed Canonical Factual Projection or explicitly governed derivative.
implementation_summary: cios/applications/flora/blueprint_import/canonical_factual_projection.py now defines the shared Canonical Factual Projection read model, executive-safe value formatting, projection versions and runtime fingerprint used by consumers.

cios/applications/flora/blueprint_import/executive_workspace.py changed executive page families so Industry Overview, Enterprise Dossiers including BT Group, Market Participants, Major Programmes, Opportunities, Reinvention, Research Gaps and Advanced Diagnostics read factual sections, Evidence, Unknowns and Contradictions from the shared projection or explicit governed derivatives.
cios/applications/flora/blueprint_import/views.py exposes deployment metadata and import/runtime fingerprints so operators can detect stale candidates before judging the visible result.

Repository tests around TEL-001 rendered pages, diagnostics reconciliation and Research Gap wording were added or updated to protect the shared-read-contract behaviour without changing TEL-001 package contents.

Industry Overview: supplied industry facts should render in executive-friendly sections
raw dictionaries and Python-style lists should not appear
diagnostics should report the same Evidence, Unknowns and Contradictions as the page
BT Group Enterprise Dossier: supplied operating model, suppliers, Evidence, Unknowns and Contradictions should remain visible
owner-assessment sections must distinguish fact present but assessment pending from fact absent
Research Gaps must not request the entire dossier where facts already exist
Market Participants: existing role, capability, relationship, activity and Evidence output should remain unchanged
Major Programmes: summary, stage and Evidence should remain visible
Opportunities: supplied customer, problem, timing and commercial fields should render where present
Reinvention: all seven source records must have an explicit visible disposition
Research Gaps: supplied facts must not be described as wholly absent
assessment pending must not be presented as missing research

unchanged_areas: Importer, validator, adapter, semantic construction, Canonical Factual Projection semantics, Observation runtime, owner assessment, Research Gaps logic, executive page semantics, TEL-001 fixture, governance and promotion remain unchanged by this operational acceptance panel.
TEL-001 package contents and checksum remain unchanged.
No automatic acceptance, promotion, recommendations or TEL-001-specific production logic is introduced.
required_test_steps: Confirm this panel shows the currently deployed SHA.
Confirm whether Flora says a fresh import is required.
Import the unchanged TEL-001 ZIP if required.
Compare the visible results against the checklist above.
fresh_import_policy: Compare deployed commit SHA, deployment timestamp, latest TEL-001 import timestamp, candidate runtime fingerprint and current runtime fingerprint. Fresh import is required when metadata is complete and the latest import predates deployment or candidate/current runtime fingerprints differ. Fresh import is not required only when metadata is complete, latest import is after deployment, and fingerprints match. Otherwise report cannot determine.
known_limitations: Operator validation cannot be inferred from repository tests and remains NOT TESTED until a human records PASS, PARTIAL or FAIL outside this repository-owned metadata.
Fresh-import guidance is Cannot determine when deployment timestamp, latest TEL-001 import timestamp, candidate runtime fingerprint or current runtime fingerprint is unavailable.
Rendered-route tests prove the acceptance panel content is visible; they do not prove a live Render deployment has been manually inspected.
Owner assessment and promotion remain governed external authorities; this change preserves candidate factual display but does not auto-authorise recommendations.
